module: Flowgraph node 'Start Auto Replay'. On the 'startNewRec' impulse, stops the current recording and starts a new one via the manager's missionReplay module; if the aiRecording module exists, also starts the AI recording and replay.
notes: work runs every frame, without testing the input impulse 'startNewRec'.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

work.desc: Calls missionReplay:startNewRec() then, if aiRecording exists, startAiRecording() and startAiReplay().
